name: Pilate
description: Ruler living at the time of the New Testament

points: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices. Pilate was a white man; he was killing the Israelites; he murdered many Israelites.

note.label: Know Your Enemy: God's Foes & Ours

points: Peter names "the God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers," who glorified his Son Jesus, whom they delivered up and denied before Pilate when Pilate was determined to let him go. The oath and promise passed through a royal lineage: Abraham had Ishmael and the sons of Keturah, but Ishmael was rejected and Isaac was chosen.

note.label: Acts 3: The Restitution of All Things

points: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together. So Herod, an Edomite, a white man that was set up by Rome to rule Jerusalem. And Pontius Pilate, another leader set up by Rome. With the Gentiles. And the people of Israel, the religious leaders. They were gathered together against Christ. Antichrist. Why? Because Herod understood, he killed thousands of black babies to prevent Christ from being born. That is antichrist. Because he knew that Christ was supposed to come, and Christ is the king, and he would not be ruling any more. The white man would not be ruling any more. So ever since Christ was born, the antichrist system was set up.

Being let go, they went to their own company and reported all, and they lifted up their voice to God with one accord: Lord, thou art God who made heaven and earth; why did the heathen rage and the people imagine vain things; the kings of the earth stood up and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord and against his Christ. Against the holy child Jesus, Herod, Pontius Pilate, the Gentiles, and the people of Israel were gathered together, and this same thing is going to happen all over again.

note.label: Acts 4: The Stone the Builders Rejected
